topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: That tree stood tall, a silent witness to the years, its branches a playground, its shade a sanctuary. Now, nothing but a stump marks the ground, a crude scar where life once flourished. The air still carries hints of its leafy presence, a ghostly reminder. The space feels wrong, an emptiness that aches. It was more than wood and leaves; it held memories, each ring a story. Now, the stories are silent, the chapters cut short. The clear sky above seems too vast, too uncaring, for the loss below.
